line: HP OmniBook X Flip 14 (2026, Panther Lake) — Spectre x360 14 successor
config_name: OmniBook X Flip 14 — Core Ultra 7 355, 16GB LPDDR5x, 512GB SSD, touch 2-in-1

battery.notes: Panther Lake efficiency cores strong in light use; convertible backlight + touch penalty. Estimate from platform; no direct CA review test.

price.notes: Reg $1,889.99; sale $1,699.99 VERIFIED via BBY API 2026-11-24 (sku 19997565). Open-box twins from $1,234-1,529.

offers.name: HP OmniBook X Flip 14" Touchscreen 2-in-1 Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 7 355 - 16GB LPDDR5x RAM - 512GB SSD - Atmospheric Blue

reviews.quote: The new OmniBook X Flip 14 is even more impressive than the OmniBook Ultra Flip 14 with more CPU performance, more ports, and a revised keyboard - though most SKUs are limited to a 60 Hz touchscreen.
An attractive, luxurious 2-in-1 that is mostly meant for laptop use, with a sturdy chassis, nice keyboard, and lots of connectivity - though the aging Radeon 880M iGPU is the weak link.

praises: Great battery life for a convertible — Panther Lake sips power in light browsing and video
Light (~1.4 kg) and thin for a 2-in-1; easy to use in tablet/tent modes
Copilot+ NPU handles on-device AI features without fan noise
BBY buyers rate it 4.14/5 across 22 reviews — screen and keyboard repeatedly called out as good for the price
Frequently discounted $200-400 off, making Panther Lake accessible
complaints: Only 16GB soldered RAM — no upgrade path and a ceiling for heavy multitasking
HP bloatware (HP Support Assistant, Maxx Audio overlays) annoys owners more than on business EliteBook line
Base 512GB SSD fills fast; storage upgrades are steeply priced (1TB OLED tier costs +$480)
60Hz non-OLED base panel looks dull next to OLED siblings; glossy touch glass reflects in bright rooms
Hinge has slight wobble when typing in tent mode (common X Flip complaint from 16" siblings)

design_philosophy: HP's OmniBook X Flip is the direct successor to the Spectre x360 14 after HP folded Spectre into the OmniBook brand: a premium-adjacent convertible that trades gem-cut styling for a cleaner aluminum chassis, Copilot+ AI positioning, and battery-first silicon. This entry tier buys the newest Panther Lake platform at the lowest price, sacrificing the OLED panel that defines the line's premium appeal.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from OmniBook X 14 clamshell reviews (NBC ~90% per ultrabooks NOTES) and OmniBook X Flip 16 sibling user sentiment; Panther Lake platform deltas applied. BBY aggregate 4.14/5 (22 reviews) used for user-sentiment calibration; no pro review of this exact CA config found (bot-walls — see SHARED-hp-convertibles.md). Image URL is refurb-twin BBY CDN image; base SKU's image field was null.
standouts: Battery-first Panther Lake in a light convertible
